```{=html}
<!--
  PIPELINE REPLAY. Included by slides.qmd via {{< include >}}.

  This is a REPLAY, not live inference. Every stage duration below is the real
  measured p50 from `pipeline_latency_development` in the benchmark bundle, so
  the clock is honest and the shape of the bar is the finding: reading the page
  and drafting the summary are 92% of the work. The OUTPUTS are canned and
  synthetic -- no model runs, nothing is fetched, and the petition is written
  for this slide. The label on the component says so, and it must stay.

  No build step, no library, no network. It has to survive a room with no wifi.
-->
<div class="replay" id="replay">
  <div class="replay-bar">
    <div class="replay-doc">Scanned petition &middot; 2 pages &middot; Odia</div>
    <div class="replay-controls">
      <button id="replay-go" class="replay-btn">Run</button>
      <button id="replay-speed" class="replay-btn replay-btn-quiet" data-mult="1">1&times;</button>
      <span class="replay-clock" id="replay-clock">0.0s</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="replay-track" id="replay-track"></div>

  <div class="replay-out">
    <div class="replay-card" data-out="redact">
      <span class="replay-card-h">Redacted text</span>
      <span class="replay-card-b">&ldquo;… the water supply to <em>[NAME]</em>&rsquo;s ward has been
      irregular for three weeks. Contact <em>[PHONE]</em> …&rdquo;</span>
    </div>
    <div class="replay-card" data-out="categorize">
      <span class="replay-card-h">Category shortlist</span>
      <span class="replay-card-b"><b>Infrastructure</b> · Social Welfare · General</span>
    </div>
    <div class="replay-card" data-out="route">
      <span class="replay-card-h">Route shortlist</span>
      <span class="replay-card-b"><b>Collector → BDO</b> · Collector → EE, RWSS</span>
    </div>
    <div class="replay-card" data-out="summarize">
      <span class="replay-card-h">Draft summary</span>
      <span class="replay-card-b">Irregular piped water supply affecting one ward
      for three weeks. Requests restoration and inspection.</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="replay-note">
    Replay at measured speed. Stage durations are the recorded p50 from the
    benchmark run; the outputs are canned and the petition is synthetic. No model
    is running.
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // Measured p50 seconds, document path, from pipeline_latency_development.
  // `heavy` marks the two stages worth engineering; everything else is noise by
  // comparison and the bar should make that obvious without a word being said.
  var STAGES = [
    { k: "ocr",        label: "Read the page",     s: 6.000, heavy: true },
    { k: "language",   label: "Detect language",   s: 0.006 },
    { k: "pii",        label: "Find personal detail", s: 0.021 },
    { k: "redact",     label: "Redact",            s: 0.053 },
    { k: "triage",     label: "Flag for review",   s: 0.001 },
    { k: "categorize", label: "Suggest category",  s: 0.749, mid: true },
    { k: "route",      label: "Suggest route",     s: 0.001 },
    { k: "summarize",  label: "Draft summary",     s: 6.590, heavy: true }
  ];
  var TOTAL = STAGES.reduce(function (a, x) { return a + x.s; }, 0);

  var root = document.getElementById("replay");
  if (!root) return;
  var track = document.getElementById("replay-track");
  var clock = document.getElementById("replay-clock");
  var go = document.getElementById("replay-go");
  var speed = document.getElementById("replay-speed");
  var timer = null;

  STAGES.forEach(function (st) {
    var seg = document.createElement("div");
    seg.className = "replay-seg" + (st.heavy ? " replay-seg-heavy" : st.mid ? " replay-seg-mid" : "");
    seg.style.flexGrow = String(st.s);
    seg.dataset.k = st.k;
    seg.innerHTML = '<span class="replay-fill"></span>' +
                    '<span class="replay-lab">' + st.label + "</span>" +
                    '<span class="replay-dur">' + (st.s >= 0.1 ? st.s.toFixed(1) + "s" : "&lt;0.1s") + "</span>";
    track.appendChild(seg);
  });

  function reset() {
    if (timer) { cancelAnimationFrame(timer); timer = null; }
    root.querySelectorAll(".replay-seg").forEach(function (e) { e.classList.remove("on", "done"); });
    root.querySelectorAll(".replay-card").forEach(function (e) { e.classList.remove("on"); });
    root.querySelectorAll(".replay-fill").forEach(function (e) { e.style.width = "0%"; });
    clock.textContent = "0.0s";
  }

  function run() {
    reset();
    var mult = parseFloat(speed.dataset.mult);
    var t0 = performance.now();
    function frame(now) {
      var elapsed = ((now - t0) / 1000) * mult;
      clock.textContent = Math.min(elapsed, TOTAL).toFixed(1) + "s";
      var acc = 0;
      STAGES.forEach(function (st) {
        var seg = track.querySelector('[data-k="' + st.k + '"]');
        var fill = seg.querySelector(".replay-fill");
        var into = elapsed - acc;
        if (into <= 0) { fill.style.width = "0%"; }
        else if (into >= st.s) {
          fill.style.width = "100%";
          seg.classList.add("done"); seg.classList.remove("on");
          var card = root.querySelector('[data-out="' + st.k + '"]');
          if (card) card.classList.add("on");
        } else {
          fill.style.width = (100 * into / st.s).toFixed(1) + "%";
          seg.classList.add("on");
        }
        acc += st.s;
      });
      if (elapsed < TOTAL) { timer = requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
      else { clock.textContent = TOTAL.toFixed(1) + "s"; timer = null; }
    }
    timer = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  go.addEventListener("click", run);
  speed.addEventListener("click", function () {
    var next = speed.dataset.mult === "1" ? "4" : "1";
    speed.dataset.mult = next;
    speed.innerHTML = next + "&times;";
  });

  // Re-arm whenever the slide is reached, so it is never left mid-run from a
  // previous pass through the deck.
  if (window.Reveal && Reveal.on) {
    Reveal.on("slidechanged", function (e) {
      if (e.currentSlide && e.currentSlide.contains(root)) reset();
    });
  }
})();
</script>
```
